answer_1.quote: Argumentation mining (AM) aims to detect argumentation structures ... we focus on the subtasks ACTC, ARI and ARTC rather than generating natural language text.

answer_2.quote: We employ the same evaluation metrics with the previous works, including F1 score and macro averaged score (denoted as Macro).

answer_3.quote: We conduct additional experiments on two prominent LLMs, namely ChatGPT-3.5-Turbo and LLAMA2... These models are used to generate predictions, not to judge the outputs.
